title: Routine
description: An NPC's daily routine (*.routine.json). One file per character. Each morning the first matching entry of 'overrides', otherwise of 'variants', decides the day's goals.

id.description: Stable identifier for this routine, with a required namespace (for example base:fabia_routine).

character.description: ID of the character who follows this routine. A character has at most one routine.

home.description: Where the character starts every morning and returns to overnight. Goals can use the destination "home".

dialogue.description: What talking to the character starts at the start of each day, until a goal sets another dialogue. Omit to leave the character's own dialogues; null for nothing to say.

overrides.description: Days that must win, such as festivals. Checked before 'variants'; the first entry whose condition is true wins.

variants.description: Ordinary days. The first entry whose condition is true wins. At least one entry needs no condition; entries after it can never be chosen.

folderPath.description: Virtual folder path for workspace organization. Empty string or absent = root.

dialogueId.description: ID of a dialogue, for example base:fabia_greeting.

oneOf.description: Nothing to say: the character cannot be talked to, whatever dialogues they have of their own.

condition.description: Read-only Lua expression, evaluated once each morning (for example Weather.IsRaining()). Omit for always true.

map.description: ID of the map, for example base:map-1.

anchor.description: ID of an anchor on that map.

slotPlace.description: An entity placed on the map that has interaction slots, such as a bench. The character sits in a free slot until the goal ends, and waits for one if all are taken. The slot supplies the animation, so the goal has no activity.

map.description: ID of the map, for example base:map-1.

entity.description: Instance ID of the placed entity on that map.

departAt.description: Time of day (HH:MM) at which the character sets off. Times increase within a routine.

condition.description: Evaluated once each morning with the variant choice. If false, the goal is skipped that day.

destination.description: Where the character goes: a map anchor, an entity with slots, or "home".

activity.description: What the character does at the destination until the next departure.

animation.description: ID of a character animation: a looping animation, an animation set or an activity animation (start, loop and end).

occupation.description: What the character is busy with once they have arrived, such as fishing. Dialogue conditions can ask for it. Omit for nothing in particular.

walkingDialogue.description: What talking to the character starts while walking to this goal. Omit to keep the dialogue in effect before; null for nothing to say.

dialogue.description: What talking to the character starts once it has arrived. Omit to keep the dialogue in effect before; null for nothing to say.

goals.description: The day's goals in time order. Empty means the character stays home all day.

entry.description: Either fixed 'goals', or 'pickOne': a pool from which one matching member is chosen at random each day.

pickOne.description: One member whose condition is true is chosen at random, weighted by 'weight'. If none match, the entry is skipped.

weight.description: Relative chance of being chosen. Defaults to 1.
